title: Sample app result card
description: The on-screen card that publishes SDK outcome into the accessibility tree. It is the evidence channel every flow asserts on, because reading structured state beats interpreting a screenshot, and on a release device it is often the only channel available. Every field is rendered as text and exposed with its test id from test-ids.json.

activeScenario.description: Flow scenario id currently in effect. Shown so a run can prove which scenario it actually got, rather than which one it asked for.

activeTheme.description: Theme scenario id currently in effect.

jobId.description: Job id as returned by the SDK. Null before a submission completes.

userId.description: User id as read back from the server response — never a locally generated placeholder. A placeholder here silently invalidates every authentication test that follows.

jobStatus.description: Current status, including the terminal distinction between cancelled and failed.

resultCallbackCount.description: Times the host result callback fired. 'Fires exactly once' is only provable by counting.

refreshCallbackCount.description: Times the token refresh callback fired. Single-flight refresh is a count assertion, not an observation.

lastError.description: Last error surfaced to the host, code and message.

sdkVersion.description: SDK version resolved at runtime. Proves which published artifact the run exercised.
